'''Z-Zeta Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] used by the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. It fought at the [[Capture of ZA-13]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
